versions.changelog:
guaikei-xhs-watch-creator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the guaikei·小红书看博主 skill.
- Enables command-line retrieval of XiaoHongShu post comments, user info, and interaction data for content and audience analysis.
- Provides four main command scenarios: keyword search, note details, comment extraction, and creator post monitoring.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access; supports public data only.
- Designed for efficient analysis of XiaoHongShu trends, community feedback, and creator output.
